tldr: Lilith in Aries: raw will and the refusal to be tamed
body: Lilith in Aries: raw will and the refusal to be tamed. Where you reclaim the right to want, fight, and exist on your own terms. Watch: rage that turns reckless. Raw will and anger: you refuse to be passive or to ask permission to want what you want. The instinct here lives in the body and needs to move. When that physical energy gets bottled up, it's the mind that pays; the way back is simple and physical, making, moving, doing, releasing energy through the body rather than sitting on it.
business: Owned, this is fearless initiative and the nerve to go first.
shadow: Suppressed it festers into resentment; unleashed, into rage and recklessness.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
